title: Layout file: the order of the islands and how many fit on a ring

ringCapacity.description: Islands on the first ring. The second ring holds one fewer, because the airport takes a place there, so a town holds at most 2 x ringCapacity - 1 pillars (23 at 12, 35 at 18). Lost & found counts as a pillar.

islands.description: Pillar codes in the order they stand round the hub: the first ringCapacity on the first ring, the rest on a staggered second ring.
